description: This Java source file defines the TaskMemoryManager class, which manages memory allocation for individual tasks in Apache Spark. It handles encoding of memory addresses for on-heap and off-heap modes, manages page tables, memory spilling, and tracks memory usage statistics.

classes.name: TaskMemoryManager
classes.description: Manages memory allocation for individual Spark tasks, including address encoding, page table management, spilling, and memory usage tracking.

methods.name: acquireExecutionMemory
methods.description: Allocates memory for a consumer, spilling from other consumers if necessary.

methods.name: trySpillAndAcquire
methods.description: Attempts to spill memory from a consumer to free up space and then acquire memory.

methods.name: releaseExecutionMemory
methods.description: Releases allocated memory for a consumer.

methods.name: showMemoryUsage
methods.description: Logs current memory usage details for the task.

methods.name: pageSizeBytes
methods.description: Returns the page size in bytes.

methods.name: allocatePage
methods.description: Allocates a large memory page for Tungsten memory sharing.

methods.name: allocatePage (private)
methods.description: Allocates a memory page with retries, managing page table entries.

methods.name: freePage
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated memory page.

methods.name: encodePageNumberAndOffset
methods.description: Encodes a page number and offset into a 64-bit address.

methods.name: decodePageNumber
methods.description: Decodes the page number from an encoded address.

methods.name: decodeOffset
methods.description: Decodes the offset within a page from an encoded address.

methods.name: getPage
methods.description: Retrieves the base object of a page from an encoded address.

methods.name: getOffsetInPage
methods.description: Retrieves the offset within a page from an encoded address.

methods.name: cleanUpAllAllocatedMemory
methods.description: Frees all allocated pages and memory, returning total bytes freed.

methods.name: getMemoryConsumptionForThisTask
methods.description: Returns current memory usage for the task.

methods.name: getTungstenMemoryMode
methods.description: Returns whether Tungsten memory mode is on-heap or off-heap.
